title: Compact Hausdorff countable-network metrization
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: For an arbitrary compact Hausdorff space, metrizability and second countability are each equivalent to the existence of a countable network of arbitrary subsets. A genuine Urysohn-function construction from pairs of network elements supplies continuous separation, and a compatible metric induces exactly the original topology. Supporting results give bounded-real-coordinate closed embeddings, preservation under continuous surjections, arbitrary-subspace heredity and compact-subspace metrization. Empty spaces and arbitrary universes are allowed. This is classical mathematics; no novelty or…
